card.name: Prepositions after verbs of sending or travel
card.fires_on: Small words like for, in, over, to, as and under right after a verb of sending, moving or traveling (sent, send, travels, move, went, come). They mostly appear in general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: After sent/send
modes.description: The word for or to follows a form of send, introducing the purpose or destination.
modes.example: stool samples from any patient with diarrhea were sent<< for>> enzyme immunoassay testing and positive

modes.label: After motion verbs
modes.description: A preposition follows a verb of travel or movement, such as travels, move, went.
modes.example: and travels<< in>> waves to the eyes of a hungry fly
